name: Diagrams and interactive visuals
description: Create inline Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed interactive HTML explanations in chat; use for flowcharts, architecture, relationships and simulations, not general websites.

name: Bug repair
description: Reproduce reported defects, trace their root cause across boundaries, preserve contracts, make focused repairs, and verify the original behavior with truthful evidence.

name: Browser interaction verification
description: Verify actual browser flows, launch routes, responsive layout, loading/failure states and visible outcomes; use for meaningful frontend behavior across design profiles, without visual templates.

name: Visual composition and critique
description: Subject-led composition and evidence-based visual critique: hierarchy, typography, spacing, imagery, meaningful motion, 3D presentation and responsive craft; no templates or separate critic stage.

name: Website layout options
description: Two credible spatial concepts and a detailed selected layout blueprint for open new websites or requested planning only; no website construction in options-only tasks.

name: Task planning and clarification
description: Plan dependent work, resolve material ambiguity, track requirements and evidence, apply human steering, and resume safely from completed actions; use for complex or changing tasks, not routine greetings or single actions.

name: Change review
description: Inspect actual code changes against the request for likely regressions before handoff; use for meaningful implementations and repairs, without spawning a separate reviewer stage.

name: Project-specific testing
description: Select the smallest useful existing project check for changed code; use after implementations and repairs, escalating only when risk or coverage requires it.

name: Refactor
description: Change structure or symbols while preserving behavior.

name: Research
description: Comprehensive deep research on technical topics and their surrounding ecosystems, architectures, trade-offs, and primary evidence.

name: Website design — Default
description: Default website design: an original, complete section with professional execution and creative autonomy.

name: Website design — Medium
description: Medium website design: a premium original section, developed efficiently with stronger creative ambition.

name: Website design — MAX
description: MAX frontend design: original premium sections; new full websites have nine or more developed sections and coordinated GSAP, ScrollTrigger and Lenis motion, with optional requested 3D.

name: GSAP animation engineering
description: GSAP timelines, animation ownership, lifecycle, responsive and reduced-motion behavior; technical implementation only, no page designs.

name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
description: Scroll-linked timelines, scrub and pin behavior, refresh, responsive teardown, and scroll-state verification; no layout recipes.

name: Lenis smooth scrolling
description: Lenis setup, GSAP/ScrollTrigger synchronization, anchors, lifecycle, touch behavior, and reduced-motion handling.

name: GSAP SVG and layout plugins
description: Technical use of Flip, DrawSVG, and MorphSVG for real layout or vector changes, including compatibility and accessible fallbacks.

name: GSAP text plugins
description: SplitText, ScrambleText, and TextPlugin mechanics, semantic reading, font and responsive re-splitting, and reduced-motion behavior.

name: Three.js WebGL engineering
description: On-demand 3D/WebGL engineering: reference-led asset construction, proportion and material fidelity, responsive rendering, lifecycle, performance and fallback; independent of the selected design profile and never a design template.

name: 3D asset sourcing and glTF pipeline
description: On-demand sourcing, provenance, inspection, validation, import and measured optimization of external 3D assets; read only when a task involves model or texture assets, never a scene template.

name: Design MAX motion implementation reference
description: Shared MAX motion guardrails and a router to the relevant library-specific skills. Technical only; no page or visual recipe.
